app_info.subtitle: Read local workspaces
app_info.description: Workspace Viewer lets ChatGPT inspect user-approved local workspaces through a read-only Agent. Users can discover registered workspaces, summarize project structure, inspect text files, search paths or file contents, and batch several read-only workspace checks into one request. It also provides a pairing flow so users can connect their own local Agent before using workspace tools.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists workspace summaries already registered for the authenticated user and does not modify workspace or Agent state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change public internet state or external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a short-lived private pairing session for the authenticated user so a local Agent can be connected.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates private application state and does not publish content or change public external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a temporary pairing code and does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns a bounded read-only summary of the selected local workspace without changing files or settings.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send data to public systems or change third-party or internet-visible state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads and returns a bounded directory tree for the selected workspace and never mutates the filesystem.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change public internet state or external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads a bounded range from a workspace text file and does not modify the file or its metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change public internet state or external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches paths or file contents inside an approved workspace and returns matches without changing stored data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change public internet state or external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs only approved read-only workspace inspection operations and returns their results without mutating files or application records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change public internet state or external third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Discover the user's available registered workspaces before choosing one to inspect.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the local workspaces I have connected.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the user's registered workspaces with enough information to identify an available target.

test_cases.description: Generate a pairing code so the user can connect a local Agent.
test_cases.user_prompt: Help me connect a new Workspace Viewer Agent on this machine.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a short-lived pairing code and a concise local Agent login command hint.

test_cases.description: Summarize the top-level structure of a selected workspace.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a quick overview of this workspace's structure before we dig into files.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise workspace summary such as root entries and project markers for the selected workspace.

test_cases.description: Inspect the directory tree under a workspace path with bounded depth.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the source tree for this workspace, but keep it shallow.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded directory tree for the selected workspace path and indicates if the result was truncated.

test_cases.description: Read a bounded section of a text file in the selected workspace.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open the README for this workspace and read the first part that explains what it does.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the requested file range with line bounds and enough context to summarize the file accurately.

test_cases.description: Search file contents for an implementation detail inside a selected workspace.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search this workspace for where the Agent WebSocket connection is created.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching file locations and concise previews that help identify the relevant implementation.

test_cases.description: Batch several read-only workspace inspections into one efficient request.
test_cases.user_prompt: Read the README, the Agent client implementation, and the Agent tools implementation together, then summarize how the Agent works.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the combined results of several read-only workspace checks so the assistant can answer with fewer tool round trips.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for requests to modify local source files because the app is read-only.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Edit my local source file and replace every TODO comment with DONE.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not modify local files.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar or scheduling requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow afternoon?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is unrelated to local workspace inspection.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for public web research requests that do not involve a connected workspace.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Search the web for the latest Cloudflare Workers pricing changes.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it inspects connected local workspaces rather than the public web.
